name: Tinanchai Bunnark
original_name: ティナンチャイ ブンナーク
source:
A 20 years old Thai hostess. She became interested in Kensuke because he reminds her of the brother Piichaai. 
She can speak japanese, but she has a funny accent and doesn't understand some words.
